findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ means pickling Sentinel members now uses the default Enum reduce, which reconstructs the member from its value. Each sentinel's value is a fresh object(), so unpickling cannot look it up and fails.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a Click object holding UNSET or FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE (e.g. a Parameter or default value) is pickled, such as when sent to a multiprocessing worker. Mechanism: the default Enum reduce returns (Sentinel, (value,)), and the value is a new object() that does not match the class's member values on load, so Sentinel(value) raises ValueError. Impact: unpickling crashes, and identity with UNSET is lost even if it did not crash.
